description: Development workflow tools. dev_loop: execute GDScript with optional validation, bridge queries, and state saving. scene_snapshot: capture structured scene tree snapshot. batch_validate: validate multiple GDScript files at once.

assertions.description: Array of assertions to run after code execution

expect_present.description: screenshot_diff: node names expected to be visible in scene tree

frames_dir.description: frame_degradation: directory of captured frames (omit if acceptance.frame_sequence captures them)

gdscript.description: GDScript code using _mcp_output to output results

reference_path.description: screenshot_diff: optional reference image path for cosine-similarity pre-filter

type.description: Assertion type: gdscript (default), screenshot_diff, or frame_degradation

frame_sequence.description: Capture N frames into a proof dir before assertions run; frames feed frame_degradation assertions

count.description: Number of frames to capture (2-60, default 12)

bridge.description: dev_loop: Optional Game Bridge for screenshot/query validation

queries.description: Bridge queries to run after code execution (max 10)

screenshot.description: Take a screenshot from the running game

path.description: Screenshot save path in game (default: user://mcp_dev_screenshot.png)

code.description: dev_loop: GDScript code to execute (snippet or full extends SceneTree)

godot_path.description: 覆盖 Godot 二进制路径（可选，优先于项目配置和环境变量）

save_state.description: dev_loop: Save session state to file

files_modified.description: List of files modified in this session

path.description: State file path relative to project (default: production/session-state/active.md)

scene_path.description: scene_snapshot: Scene file path relative to project

scripts.description: batch_validate: Array of script paths relative to project

timeout.description: dev_loop: Timeout per step in seconds (default: 30)

verify.description: dev_loop: Also run project validation after execution (default: false)

name: workflow
